name: rouge-1-rl-001
question: Does one RSI iteration (the base answers verifiable problems, only code-verified answers are trained into every language-model weight) improve held-out verifiable math without breaking general skills?

method.kind: ReST-EM style self-training (Singh et al. 2023, 'Beyond Human Data'); full-parameter, FSDP2
method.sample: 3,200 verifiable prompts (numeric answers; OpenR1-Math-220k and OpenMathReasoning problems, teacher solutions unused) x 4 answers, thinking on, T=1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, at most 6,144 new tokens
method.select: code-checked answers only (evaluate.check numeric); prompts solved sometimes contribute up to 2 correct answers, prompts always solved 1 answer for a fixed 25% (hash), prompts never solved nothing
method.train: selected answers + the dataset's in-house generated records and human-written German (aya, oasst); 2 epochs, lr 5e-6 cosine, AdamW (0.9, 0.95), global batch 32 sequences of <= 8k tokens, vision tower frozen

checkpoint.name: rouge-1-rl-001
checkpoint.contents: BF16 safetensors of the base class with the base-only MTP tensors carried over; stored in the private Lightning model registry; the repository keeps the checkpoint manifest (sha256 of every file)

suites.primary: 300 held-out verifiable math problems from the same sources as the prompts, never among them (numeric answer check)
suites.guard: 500 items: MGSM en 100, MGSM de 100, MBPP 100 (unit tests executed), IFEval 200 (strict, supported instructions)
suites.report: 64 items, never decisive: generated format and German items, identity 4

eval.blind: Scoring is code only; base and candidate run with identical settings on the same items in the same job; cli compare --prereg refuses a different eval set.

decision.rule: PASS if the primary suite improves (candidate > base, McNemar exact p < 0.05) AND no guard category drops by 5 points or more, or by any amount with p < 0.05. Otherwise FAIL.

next.PASS: rouge-1-rl-001 becomes the parent of the next iteration (rouge-1-rl-002 samples from it); convert to Rouge Edge (GGUF) on a free CPU job and measure it
next.FAIL: the base stays Rouge 1 v0; change prompts, selection or hyperparameters and register rouge-1-rl-002; the same recipe does not get more compute

budget.machine: H200_X_8 (8 x H200 141 GB, NVLink), live price 36.00 USD/h on 2026-09-30
budget.enforced: worst case = max hours x live price x 1.05 within the ceiling (cost.CEILING_USD) and the teamspace balance; the trainer stops at its own budget check
budget.approval: the owner approves the run in the protected GitHub environment rouge-gpu

re_registration: 2026-10-01: base changed to Qwen3.8-27B (owner decision) before any training; the dataset is rebuilt so its identity records name the new base, and the eval hash is set again from that build
